title: Coating strength: a curved world
scope: Fictional independent coating preparations under a fixed protocol. Fit at 20–40 degC; other temperatures explore extrapolation.
source: Synthetic teaching data: 64 preparations generated with seed 817, a quadratic mean and Gaussian SD 4 MPa. Not measurements of real coatings.
assumptions: Analyst interpretation: the mean can turn downward as temperature rises, with common variability. No causal interpretation has been established.
structure: Predictions condition on the supplied inputs; predictor frequencies are not modeled.
Each simulated experiment uses one shared parameter draw and conditionally independent outcomes at the supplied rows.
The Gaussian likelihood permits negative outcomes and uses a common residual SD across these scenarios.
